coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property in the City of San Diego. That term is borrowed from SDMC § 98.0702: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park. No unit-count, construction-date, landlord-size or owner-occupancy limits are stated. Division 11 incorporates only the Division 7 definitions, not the Division 7 exemptions in § 98.0703.

result.notes:
1. Removed other_conditions. It described the regulated software (landlord conduct), not buildings, units or owners.
2. Removed the Cartwright Act / Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729 reference from the summary. It is not supported by any document provided.
3. The § 98.0703 exemptions (e.g. the 15-year certificate-of-occupancy exemption and the affordable-housing exemptions) do not carry over. They apply to 'This Division' (Division 7) only, and Division 11 borrows only the definitions of landlord, lease, residential rental property and tenant. So unverifiable_exemptions stays empty.
4. The affordable-housing software carve-out in § 98.1102(b) excludes a type of device, not a class of buildings. It is not listed as a coverage exemption.
5. requires_unknown_facts remains false because the rule covers ordinary residential rental property citywide.
